<div class="card-body">
'''Leia''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] from [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">レイア</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">オルデランの総督兼第一議長の養女。若くして政治的なリーダーとなる。皇帝の勅令の非道さに反発して、反乱軍に加わった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Leia.

'''Lore:''' Adopted daughter of Alderaan's governor and first chairman. She became a political leader at a young age. She joined the Rebellion in opposition to the cruelty of the Emperor's edicts.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore refers to the cruelty of the Emperor's edicts.
<h2>Notes</h2>
'''Leia (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Leia (Jedi Pack)|Leia]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] in January 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Leia (Japanese ESB Two-Player)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R63 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30, Reflections II foil cards, R63. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Leia-Reflections-II-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins.</ref>
